title: Lucy Powell to visit China to promote UK education weeks after MI5 warning
summary_full: Delegation of 50 to accompany minister, with trip criticised after universities were warned about Chinese interferenceThe education secretary, Lucy Powell, is travelling to Beijing this week to promote UK education, weeks after MI5 issued a rare public warning to universities about Chinese interference in UK academia.A 50-strong UK delegation, including 18 university leaders, will accompany the minister when she attends the first UK-China education summit in nine years, aimed at opening up new opportunities for universities, colleges and education businesses.
